Iran Claims US Response to Hormuz Proposal Insufficient

Iran has stated that the United States' response to its proposal for reopening the Strait of Hormuz was insufficient. According to Iranian claims, the US accepted some of Iran's seven conditions. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil shipments.
